findings.evidence: Grep finds only `isIso_singularCohomologyMap_of_forall_isIso` (Relative.lean:249) and no instance for `e.hom` of an `Iso` of pairs. The PR proves it privately at SubspaceCompl.lean:293 and again inline at ProdThomPair.lean:270.
findings.fix: Make it a public `instance` in TauCeti/AlgebraicTopology/Cohomology/Relative.lean, then delete the private lemma and the inline `have` in ProdThomPair.lean.
findings.issue: `isIso_singularCohomologyMap_hom` (an isomorphism of pairs induces an isomorphism on cohomology) is general infrastructure kept private. The same fact is re-derived inline in Cohomology/ProdThomPair.lean:270.

findings.evidence: Its statement mentions only `TopPair.ofInclusion`, `TopPair.ofSubset` and `Set.univ`. The proof uses only `TopPair.isIso_of_isIso_fst_of_surjective_snd` and `Homeomorph.Set.univ`.
findings.fix: Move it to TauCeti/Topology/Category/TopPair.lean as a public iso (for example `TopPair.ofInclusionUnivIso`) and use it here.
findings.issue: `univHom`/`univIso : TopPair.ofInclusion (Set.subset_univ A) ≅ TopPair.ofSubset A` is a generic fact about pairs, unrelated to subspace complements, yet it is private here.

findings.evidence: `extend_apply_v` itself is proved as `(LinearMap.congr_fun s.extend_comp_subtype s.v).trans s.apply_v`, which is the missing general lemma specialized to `v`.
findings.fix: Add `@[simp] lemma extend_apply (w : s.W') : s.extend w = s.φ w` (proved by `LinearMap.congr_fun s.extend_comp_subtype w`).
findings.issue: The newly public `extend` has no pointwise characterizing lemma on `W'`. Only the composite equation `extend_comp_subtype` is provided, so users must apply `LinearMap.congr_fun` themselves.

summary: Two general results are hidden as private in the new subspace-complement cohomology file instead of being exported from their canonical homes, and the newly public `LineExtension.extend` lacks its pointwise characterizing simp lemma.
